newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market enjoys more positive tone.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market enjoys more positive tone.

text.p: Strength in Australian and South African auctions underpinned a modest rise in orders and more local enquiry among early stage processors, while market participants said they considered the outlook more positive than for some time.
Downstream resistance to higher prices persists, particularly at the retail end, but is beginning to ease as a consensus develops that scope for sharp decline in raw wool values is limited.

The main variable is currency, with strong sterling offsetting Australian cent price increases. Wool top quotations are on average unchanged but some firms have made slight downward adjustments based on currency movement - while others tweaked prices to catch up with raw material rises.
